name: Filament PM (Plasty Mladec)
summary: Czech filament brand launched in 2013 by Plasty Mladec, a plastics extruder founded in 1992 that originally made plastic profiles and welding wire. Around 16 filament types in 1.75 mm and 2.85 mm, including carbon-fibre CFJet, wood-filled WoodJet and recycled RePLA+/RePETG lines, distributed to roughly 30 countries. An official Prusa Research filament partner since 2014.

oem_relationships.notes: Long-running official filament partnership since 2014, described as co-branding/partner supply rather than pure resale. Not listed in research/verified-oem-relationships.md; sourced from Filament PM's own about pages and industry profiles, so the exact commercial form of the partnership is unverified.

product_lines.name: SILK
product_lines.notes: Silk-finish line (e.g. Golden Glory); base polymer PLA assumed - the TDS could not be fetched (robots.txt), so blend vs additive is unconfirmed

product_lines.name: FRJET

product_lines.name: PEIJET 1010 ULTEM
product_lines.notes: Targets Ultem 1010 chemistry per the SKU name; genuine-resin vs PEI blend not independently confirmed

product_lines.name: TPU 96
product_lines.notes: TPU, Shore ~96A implied by the product name; TDS confirmation pending

product_lines.name: ESD
product_lines.notes: Static-dissipative filament; base polymer varies by SKU (likely carbon-doped PLA or PETG) and is unconfirmed

additional_notes: Parent Plasty Mladec operates its own extrusion lines in Mladec, Czech Republic; the company grew from 3 employees to 50+ on the back of the filament business. A separate UK-facing site runs at https://www.filament-pm.co.uk/. No build-plate or print-surface products found. Price tier recorded as premium given the engineering-leaning CF/PA range, though the commodity PLA/PET-G lines sit closer to mid.

provenance.conflicts: The Prusa Research relationship is encoded as manufactures-for based on a long-standing 'official filament partner' description; whether Prusa-branded filament is actually extruded by Plasty Mladec, or the partnership is only distribution/profile co-branding, was not established. Legal form of the parent is cited inconsistently across sources (a.s. vs s.r.o.). Exact $/kg unconfirmed.
